meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 为选定的 NanoClaw 分组装上 Tavily 远程 MCP 服务：把 mcp-remote 桥接写进 agent 镜像并注册 tavily 服务，最终可用 tavily_search 与 tavily_extract 两个工具，全程不需要 API key。
howto.when: 当你要给指定分组安装免密钥的 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 提取时触发；若 Tavily 返回 429，说明免密钥额度用尽，agent 会转而提供付费 key 升级。

say.text: 给 <group-id> 分组装上 Tavily 搜索和提取工具
say.note: 会注册 tavily 服务并重启该分组

say.text: 看看 mcp-remote 是不是已经在镜像清单里
say.note: 会检查 cli-tools.json 并列出分组

say.text: 查一下 <group-id> 的配置里有没有 tavily 服务
say.note: 显示该组已存储的 MCP 配置

howto.what_en: Installs Tavily's remote MCP server for selected NanoClaw agent groups: adds the pinned mcp-remote bridge to the agent image and registers a tavily server, giving you tavily_search and tavily_extract with no API key.
howto.when_en: Use when installing keyless Tavily web search or URL extraction for selected agent groups. If Tavily returns 429, the keyless allowance is spent and the agent offers the paid-key upgrade.

say_en.text: Install Tavily search and extract for group <group-id>
say_en.note: Registers the tavily MCP server, then restarts the group

say_en.text: Check whether mcp-remote is already in the image manifest
say_en.note: Greps cli-tools.json and lists your groups

say_en.text: Show the stored config for <group-id> to confirm the tavily server
